name: Okendo
description: Okendo is a customer-marketing platform for ecommerce reviews, loyalty, referrals, surveys, quizzes, customer profiles, and user-generated content.
agentUseSummary: Okendo cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its server-side Merchant REST API requires an entitled merchant's store-specific User ID and static API key over HTTP Basic Auth, with broad CRUD authority and no published granular permission or delegated OAuth contract; representative credential and entitlement acceptance is required first.

credentialRequirements.label: Okendo User ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Merchant identifier from Okendo integration settings.

credentialRequirements.helpText: Store-specific static API key stored only in Railway's encrypted credential boundary.

blocked.label: Collect Okendo credentials
blocked.description: Relay does not collect static merchant credentials before representative paid-account and lifecycle acceptance.

blocked.label: Substitute storefront APIs
blocked.description: Public storefront APIs do not establish private merchant ownership or server-side authority.

blocked.label: Access Okendo data
blocked.description: Reviews, reviewers, customers, loyalty, referrals, surveys, quizzes, settings, and webhook data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Mutate or use raw Okendo APIs
blocked.description: Review moderation and replies, groups, loyalty changes, webhook subscriptions, arbitrary endpoints, pagination, and raw responses are blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: Okendo Merchant REST API access requires an entitled merchant to retrieve a store-specific User ID and 32-character API key. The same unscoped Basic Auth credential reaches broad review, loyalty, survey, quiz, customer, settings, and webhook CRUD surfaces, while public documentation does not establish key rotation/revocation or representative product entitlements.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should obtain authorization from a representative Advanced merchant or Power merchant with the API add-on, provision dedicated credentials without exposing them in reports, record enabled products and rotation/revocation behavior, inspect exact schemas and quotas without external writes, and return the frozen authority contract before connector implementation.

evidence.supports: Okendo documents a merchant-only server-side REST API using HTTPS Basic Auth with the Okendo User ID and a unique static API key from integration settings, a two-request-per-second rate, header versioning, and nextUrl pagination.
Okendo's quick start confirms User ID plus API key authentication and exposes published reviews containing review body, order, reviewer email and identity, reward, moderation, and media data.
The same Basic Auth contract covers review listing and retrieval plus moderation updates, customer-notifying replies, and group creation.
Okendo states API access is included on Advanced and above or available as a paid Power add-on, and that API keys are store-specific and retrieved from Okendo Admin.
